description: This React component 'RoadmapLibrary' manages a list of saved roadmaps, allowing users to preview and open them. It fetches data via API calls, manages state for loading, errors, and previews, and navigates to the main roadmap view when opening a roadmap.

methods.name: RoadmapLibrary({ userId = "demo-user", onLoadRoadmap })
methods.description: React functional component that displays a list of saved roadmaps, with preview and open functionalities.

methods.name: handlePreview
methods.description: Handles the preview toggle and data fetching for a specific roadmap.

methods.name: handleOpen
methods.description: Loads a selected roadmap and calls a callback or navigates to the main view.
